slides.chapter: 01. Scan QR Code to Start Ride
slides.spoken_text: アプリでQRコードをスキャンして利用を開始します。
slides.meaning: Scan the QR code with the app to start using the bike.
slides.tip: Use the て-form (スキャンして) to connect consecutive actions smoothly.

tokens.kana: きゅーあーるこーどを

slides.sentence_ja: アプリでQRコードをスキャンして利用を開始します。
slides.grammar_title: Grammar Pattern: Verb て-form + Main Verb (Sequence of Actions)
grammar_bullets: Use the て-form to list chronological actions: scan QR code -> start ride.
LUUP electric kickboards and Docomo red bikes are everywhere in central Tokyo.
You must reserve a return port in advance via the app before parking.
Never abandon bikes outside designated port lines to avoid heavy fines.
